subject: RP11 code review complete — 1 bug fixed, 1 flag for you
body:
FA — RP11 full code review done per Marcus request. Here is the summary.

MATH AUDIT: 15/15 questions verified correct. All answers unique vs RP1-10. 325/325 validator checks pass. No corrupted strings in question_html. Sections and standards coverage clean.

BUG FIXED: Q13 graph had min_points=4. Every other graph in every exam uses min_points=5. Fixed to 5 before this note was written.

FLAG — Q11 DIFFICULTY: The fractional exponent question is 3x^(2/3)-4=104, answer x=216. The solution requires knowing 36^(3/2) = (sqrt(36))^3 = 6^3 = 216. This is the hardest fractional exponent Kai has seen — RP10 had x=81 (x^(3/4)=27, simpler cube). I included a cube table in the solution steps as a scaffold. The question is math-correct and schema-valid. Marcus has been flagged. He said Q11 is intentional (teacher's exam has a similar type). No change pending, but I wanted you aware in case you want to review difficulty calibration for the W3.b standard.

REPO NOTE: Local branch is diverged from origin (6 local vs 843 remote). I have not pushed. Marcus said not to push. Flagging so you and GP are aware — there may be a merge operation needed before next deploy.

- GA
